headline: Abatements for 1593 Northampton Street and 14 Brenton Lane, and a fuel depot price increase.
summary: The agenda lists two abatements, a contract amendment for ARPA-funded sewer rehabilitation, River Terrace change orders, and a fuel depot price increase. It also includes a Holyoke Water Works contract update and a sewer shut-off program update.

Other topics the Chair did not anticipate 48 hours in advance
